tasks.title: Set up project environment and dependencies
tasks.description: Initialize the project with Godot 4.5.1 .NET, .NET 8 SDK, and ensure packages.lock.json is present.
tasks.details:
Story: PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001
ADR Refs: ADR-0031; ADR-0011
Chapters: CH01; CH06; CH07; CH10
Overlays: docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/_index.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Contracts-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Testing-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Observability-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md
Test Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs; Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs; Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs; Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1WindowsPlatformGateTests.cs
Acceptance: task-0001.json must include machine-readable fields for godot_version, dotnet_version, packages_lock_exists, and evidence_paths; missing any field fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs; task-0001.json must provide explicit pass/fail conclusions for Windows-only and UTF-8 compliance with traceable evidence sources; vague statements (for example, "checked") fail acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs; ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md must list all evidence paths for Task 1, and every path must resolve to an existing file under logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/; any broken path fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs; On Windows, GODOT_BIN must be set to the absolute path of the Godot 4.5.1 .NET console executable, and .NET-console flavor must be proven by both executable identity evidence and version-command output captured from that exact path; task-0001.json must record godot_bin_env.env_var_name="GODOT_BIN", godot_bin_env.env_var_value (absolute path), godot_bin_env.env_var_scope (Process/User/Machine), and installation verification result. Missing any required field or non-absolute path fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs; Must execute `& $env:GODOT_BIN --version`; command must succeed and stdout must include "4.5.1". Running `godot --version` is optional evidence when PATH is configured; if provided, it must also report "4.5.1". Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs; Must persist full stdout of `& $env:GODOT_BIN --version` to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/godot-bin-version.txt; when `godot --version` is available, its full stdout must be persisted to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/godot-version.txt. Missing required evidence file fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs; task-0001.json must record command, exit_code, parsed_version, and evidence_file for each Godot version command; missing any key fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs; After installing .NET 8 SDK, running `dotnet --version` must start with "8.", and `dotnet --list-sdks` must contain at least one 8.x SDK entry; 7.x, 9.x, empty output, missing 8.x SDK entry, or command failure fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs; If packages.lock.json is missing before restore, running `dotnet restore .\NewRouge.sln` must generate it; if it already exists, it must remain present and correspond to the same NewRouge.sln restore scope. A lock file outside the NewRouge.sln restore scope does not satisfy acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs; Before toolchain checks are accepted, `.\NewRouge.sln` must exist in repository workspace and be the exact restore target used in evidence; missing solution file or mismatched restore target fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs; Must create logs/ directory structure for evidence, including at minimum logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/, and store readable evidence files covering Godot version checks, dotnet version, dotnet SDK list, packages.lock.json existence, Windows-only result, and UTF-8 result; any missing required directory or evidence file fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs; Acceptance artifacts must explicitly back-link ADR-0031 and ADR-0011 (for example via refs in task-0001.json and ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md); missing either ADR reference fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs; UTF-8 compliance must be validated at file level: task-0001.json, ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md, and generated evidence files under logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/ must decode as UTF-8 without errors; task-0001.json must include utf8_check.result="pass", utf8_check.checked_files (non-empty), and utf8_check.evidence_file. Any decode failure or missing required field fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs; Windows-only is a hard gate: os_platform must be Windows, and task-0001.json must include windows_only_check.result="pass" with platform evidence. Non-Windows or missing evidence fails and must stop downstream gates. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1WindowsPlatformGateTests.cs; Must persist full stdout of `dotnet restore .\NewRouge.sln` to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/dotnet-restore.txt; missing evidence file fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs; task-0001.json must include dotnet_restore.command, dotnet_restore.exit_code, and dotnet_restore.evidence_file; dotnet_restore.command must target NewRouge.sln (semantic equivalent of `dotnet restore .\NewRouge.sln`), and dotnet_restore.exit_code must equal 0. Missing any key, wrong restore target, or non-zero exit_code fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs
Test Strategy: Check Godot version via 'godot --version', .NET version via 'dotnet --version', and verify packages.lock.json exists. Log environment evidence to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/. Refs: ADR-0031, ADR-0011.
Labels: newrouge; m1; ci
Owner: gameplay
Layer: ci
tasks.testStrategy: Check Godot version via 'godot --version', .NET version via 'dotnet --version', and verify packages.lock.json exists. Log environment evidence to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/. Refs: ADR-0031, ADR-0011.

tasks.title: Create core project structure and namespaces
tasks.description: Establish directory boundaries: Game.Core, Game.Godot, Game.Core.Tests, Tests.Godot. Enforce NewRouge.* namespace.
tasks.details:
Story: PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001
ADR Refs: ADR-0024
Chapters: CH01; CH06; CH07; CH05
Overlays: docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/_index.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Contracts-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Testing-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Observability-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md
Test Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0002_acceptance.gd; Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2NamespaceCoexistenceTests.cs; Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs
Acceptance: Repository root must contain Game.Core/, Game.Godot/, Game.Core.Tests/, and Tests.Godot/. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0002_acceptance.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2NamespaceCoexistenceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs; Game.Core/, Game.Core.Tests/, and Tests.Godot/ must each contain a .csproj with TargetFramework=net8.0 and Nullable=enable; Game.Godot/ is a script/resource directory and must not contain any standalone .csproj. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0002_acceptance.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs; Game.Core must not reference any Godot package or API. taskdoc/task-0002-change-set.json is the authoritative Task 2 C# scope and must include Game.Core/Conventions and Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2* entries (plus optional Tests.Godot Task2 C# entries); every listed file must declare namespaces under NewRouge.*; legacy Game.* may remain outside Task 2 scope. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0002_acceptance.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2NamespaceCoexistenceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs; If legacy Game.* namespaces are present, they may coexist with NewRouge.*; Task 2 does not require full repository rename. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2NamespaceCoexistenceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs; Task 2 completion must include sc-acceptance-check step `dotnet-build-warnaserror` with exit_code=0 as root build proof; if this gate is not executed or fails, Task 2 must remain non-done and progression must be blocked. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs
Test Strategy: Validate root directories and .csproj settings for Game.Core, Game.Core.Tests, and Tests.Godot; treat Game.Godot as script/resource directory. Refs: ADR-0024.; Gate evidence: root build pass is enforced by sc-acceptance-check dotnet-build-warnaserror (exit code 0, no compiler errors), and Task2RootBuildGateTests validates build output classification.; Evidence note: structure snapshot may be stored as logs/ci/<date>/task-0002-structure.txt for review traceability.; Evidence note: capture sc-acceptance-check summary at logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/sc-acceptance-check-task-2/summary.json and keep dotnet-build-warnaserror step status for audit (non-Refs evidence).

tasks.title: Implement core contracts for card identity and forms
tasks.description: Define contracts in Game.Core/Contracts for card identity, forms (Base, U1A, U1B, Ultimate), and upgrade fields per ADR-0033.
tasks.details:
Story: PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001
ADR Refs: ADR-0033; ADR-0020
Chapters: CH01; CH06; CH07; CH05
Overlays: docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/_index.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Contracts-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Testing-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Observability-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md
Test Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs
Acceptance: 在 Game.Core/Contracts 中定义 CardDefinition 与 CardInstance 契约：CardDefinition 至少包含 card_id，CardInstance 至少包含 instance_id、upgrade_tier、upgrade_route、permanent_card_instance_modifiers；并定义 Form 枚举（Base/U1A/U1B/Ultimate）与 Route 枚举（A/B）。上述契约需可被纯 .NET 测试项目直接引用并编译通过，且不得依赖任何 Godot 类型或命名空间。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs; 升级语义必须可被测试直接判定：当 upgrade_tier=2 时，upgrade_route 必须为 null；当 upgrade_tier 不为 2 且提供 upgrade_route 时，其值仅允许 A 或 B。对违反“tier=2 且 route 非 null”的输入，测试必须产生显式失败结果，且不能通过跳过断言、空测试、默认值回退或静默修正掩盖问题。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs; 在 Game.Core.Tests/Contracts 下新增或更新 xUnit 测试，覆盖契约字段定义、Form/Route 枚举成员完整性、以及 tier=2→route=null 约束的正反两类用例；并验证测试工程保持纯 .NET 依赖且未引入 Godot 依赖。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs; In Game.Core/Contracts, CardDefinition and CardInstance must be interface or class (record class allowed); reflection tests assert IsInterface or IsClass and reject other shapes. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs; Game.Core.Tests/Contracts must include reflection assertions that CardDefinition and CardInstance are IsInterface or IsClass (including record class); any other type shape fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs; Negative tests must assert explicit failure when CardDefinition or CardInstance is struct, enum, or any non interface/class shape; missing negative gate fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs
Test Strategy: Write xUnit tests in Game.Core.Tests/Contracts to validate contract definitions and upgrade field constraints. Ensure no Godot dependencies. Refs: ADR-0033, ADR-0020.
Labels: newrouge; m1; core; cards
Owner: gameplay
Layer: core
tasks.testStrategy: Write xUnit tests in Game.Core.Tests/Contracts to validate contract definitions and upgrade field constraints. Ensure no Godot dependencies. Refs: ADR-0033, ADR-0020.

tasks.title: Implement core contracts for offer locking and deterministic outcomes
tasks.description: Define contracts for offer locking structure, provenance, and RNG streams per ADR-0032 and Design Gate 05.
tasks.details: Create classes for OfferLocking with fields: stable_ids[], display_order[], provenance (source_type, source_id, act, floor, node_id, difficulty, rng_stream, stream_pos), rng_stream, locked_at_save_point. Define RNG stream types (run, combat, event, loot, shop, offer). Ensure stable_ids use content stable IDs. Refs: ADR-0032.
tasks.testStrategy: Write xUnit tests to validate offer locking structure and provenance fields. Test serialization/deserialization for deterministic behavior. Refs: ADR-0032.
tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Implement core contracts for offer locking and deterministic outcomes.

tasks.title: Implement core contracts for status and modifier system
tasks.description: Define contracts for status types (Buff, Debuff, RuleModifier), fields, and deterministic ordering per Design Gate 04.
tasks.details: Create Status class with fields: status_id, stacks, duration_turns, source_id, expires_timing. Define enums for StatusType and ExpiresTiming. Include methods for stacking, duration accumulation, and decay. Ensure RuleModifier and status.strength are non-dispellable. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0029.
tasks.testStrategy: Write xUnit tests for status operations: stacking, duration handling, and dispel boundaries. Validate deterministic ordering via stable_id sorting. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0029.
tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Implement core contracts for status and modifier system.

tasks.title: Implement core contracts for combat loop and resolution pipeline
tasks.description: Define contracts for combat phases, damage calculation, and deterministic sequencing per Design Gates 01 and 03.
tasks.details: Create classes for CombatLoop with phases: StartOfTurn, Draw, Main, EndOfTurn. Define resolution pipeline steps: Validate, ComputeCost, PayCost, BeforePlayTriggers, ResolveEffect, AfterPlayTriggers, MoveCard, DeathCheck. Implement damage calculation with Strength, Weak, Vulnerable multipliers. Include OverplayTax logic for difficulty >=10. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0032.
tasks.testStrategy: Write xUnit tests for combat phase transitions, damage calculation, and OverplayTax application. Ensure deterministic ordering via combatant_id and stable_id. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0032.

subtasks.title: Define combat loop phases and transition guards
subtasks.details: Define StartOfTurn, Draw, Main, and EndOfTurn phase transitions with explicit preconditions and failure behavior that leaves state unchanged.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add xUnit tests for valid transitions and invalid transition rejection with unchanged state.

subtasks.title: Specify deterministic PlayCard pipeline contract
subtasks.details: Implement and lock the step order Validate -> ComputeCost -> PayCost -> BeforePlayTriggers -> ResolveEffect -> AfterPlayTriggers -> MoveCard -> DeathCheck.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add xUnit trace-order tests asserting exact pipeline sequence for deterministic execution.

subtasks.title: Implement damage multipliers and fixed-damage rules
subtasks.details: Implement Strength, Weak, and Vulnerable multipliers and preserve fixed-damage exemption from mutable multipliers as defined by contracts.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use table-driven xUnit tests to validate multiplier math and fixed-damage invariants.

subtasks.title: Add OverplayTax and ordering determinism checks
subtasks.details: Apply OverplayTax only when difficulty >= 10 and enforce deterministic ordering by combatant_id and stable_id.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add xUnit tests for difficulty threshold behavior and same-input same-output ordering.

tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Implement core contracts for combat loop and resolution pipeline.

tasks.title: Set up event bus and contracts location
tasks.description: Implement event bus system and place contracts in Game.Core/Contracts per ADR-0004 and ADR-0020.
tasks.details: Create EventBus interface in Game.Core/Contracts with publish/subscribe methods. Define event DTOs for game events (e.g., CardPlayed, CombatStarted). Ensure Godot layer references these contracts without duplication. Use composition root for dependency injection. Refs: ADR-0004, ADR-0020.
tasks.testStrategy: Write xUnit tests for event publishing and subscription. Verify contracts are in correct location and not duplicated in Godot scripts. Refs: ADR-0004, ADR-0020.
tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Set up event bus and contracts location.

tasks.title: Implement core logic for card identity and forms
tasks.description: Create core services for card definition, instance management, and form transitions per ADR-0033.
tasks.details: Implement CardService with methods to get card definition by card_id, create instances, upgrade (U1 route selection), and advance to Ultimate. Ensure form transitions inherit permanent_card_instance_modifiers. Validate upgrade_tier and upgrade_route constraints. Refs: ADR-0033.
tasks.testStrategy: Write xUnit tests in Game.Core.Tests/Cards for card identity, upgrade paths, and modifier inheritance. Reference ADR-0033 in test descriptions. Refs: ADR-0033.

subtasks.title: Implement card definition lookup by card_id
subtasks.details: Implement CardService lookup for CardDefinition by card_id with deterministic not-found failure behavior.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add xUnit tests for hit/miss lookup behavior and deterministic failure outputs.

subtasks.title: Implement card instance creation and base form init
subtasks.details: Create CardInstance with instance_id, base form, and initialized modifier container consistent with contract fields.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add xUnit tests for instance field initialization and identity separation from card definitions.

subtasks.title: Implement U1 upgrade route constraints
subtasks.details: Implement route A/B selection rules for U1 upgrades and enforce invalid route/tier combinations as hard failures.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add xUnit positive and negative tests for route constraints and tier-route invariants.

subtasks.title: Implement Ultimate transition and modifier inheritance
subtasks.details: Implement transition to Ultimate and preserve permanent_card_instance_modifiers inheritance semantics across form transitions.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add xUnit tests asserting modifier inheritance continuity and final-form transition constraints.

tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Implement core logic for card identity and forms.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic RNG stream registry
tasks.description: Create RNG stream registry and state management for deterministic systems.
tasks.details: Implement RNGStreamRegistry with named streams (run, combat, event, loot, shop, offer). Provide seed/state serialization and stream position tracking. Ensure UI actions do not advance RNG. Refs: ADR-0032, ADR-0021.
tasks.testStrategy: xUnit tests for stream isolation, seed/state serialization, and non-advancing UI actions. Refs: ADR-0032.
tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Implement deterministic RNG stream registry.

tasks.title: Implement status application, stacking, and decay
tasks.description: Create status operations: apply, stack, decay, and dispel boundaries.
tasks.details: Implement StatusService core operations: apply status (add when missing and stack when existing), stack rules (e.g., duration + N), decay timing at owner_end_of_turn_cleanup, and dispel only Debuffs. When decay consumes duration to 0, the status must be removed from target state. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0029.
tasks.testStrategy: xUnit tests must cover add-vs-stack apply behavior, duration decay timing and expiry-removal at owner_end_of_turn_cleanup, plus dispel boundaries (remove Debuff, keep Buff/RuleModifier). Refs: ADR-0029.
tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Implement status application, stacking, and decay.

tasks.title: Implement combat resolution pipeline (core)
tasks.description: Implement card play pipeline and validation steps in core combat logic.
tasks.details: Implement CombatService PlayCard pipeline: Validate, ComputeCost, PayCost, BeforePlay, ResolveEffect, AfterPlay, MoveCard, DeathCheck (pipeline hooks). Focus on deterministic ordering, and require PayCost to consume exactly the ComputeCost output exactly once on successful paths. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0032.
tasks.testStrategy: xUnit tests for pipeline step ordering and deterministic execution with fixed inputs. Refs: ADR-0032.

subtasks.title: Implement PlayCard pipeline orchestrator skeleton
subtasks.details: Create CombatService pipeline orchestrator and wire fixed phase sequence hooks without embedding UI concerns.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add xUnit tests verifying pipeline step invocation order under nominal input.

subtasks.title: Implement validation and cost payment gates
subtasks.details: Implement Validate, ComputeCost, and PayCost stages with fail-fast semantics that prevent downstream stage execution on failure.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add xUnit tests asserting blocked progression and unchanged state on validation or payment failure.

subtasks.title: Implement resolve-effect and trigger stages
subtasks.details: Implement BeforePlay, ResolveEffect, and AfterPlay stage behavior with deterministic ordering and stable side-effect boundaries.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add xUnit tests for trigger ordering and deterministic effect resolution traces.

subtasks.title: Implement MoveCard and DeathCheck finalization
subtasks.details: Finalize pipeline with MoveCard and DeathCheck stages and guarantee same-input same-output deterministic end state.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add xUnit tests for final stage behavior and deterministic final state snapshots.

tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Implement combat resolution pipeline (core).

tasks.title: Implement save serialization and atomic write
tasks.description: Create SaveService serialization, schema versioning, and atomic write.
tasks.details: Implement SaveService to serialize run state (schema_version, save_point_id, offer locks) and write atomically to user://. Do not handle migration logic here. Refs: ADR-0032, ADR-0023.
tasks.testStrategy: xUnit tests for serialization round-trip and atomic write behavior. Refs: ADR-0032.

subtasks.title: Define run save serialization shape
subtasks.details: Serialize schema_version, save_point_id, and offer locks into save payload and keep migration concerns out of this task scope.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add xUnit round-trip serialization tests for required fields and shape stability.

subtasks.title: Implement atomic write commit workflow
subtasks.details: Write through a temporary file and replace target atomically to avoid partial save corruption on interruption.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add xUnit tests that verify commit behavior and no partial-file state after write failures.

subtasks.title: Enforce user:// path safety boundaries
subtasks.details: Allow save writes only under user:// and reject absolute or traversal-like paths with fail-fast errors.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add xUnit tests for allowed user:// path and denied invalid path cases.

subtasks.title: Add persistence error propagation and evidence fields
subtasks.details: Return contextual errors on save failure and emit required persistence evidence fields without mutating last valid save.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add xUnit tests asserting error propagation and unchanged previous save on failure path.

tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Implement save serialization and atomic write.

tasks.title: Set up Godot autoloads and composition root
tasks.description: Configure Godot autoloads (EventBus, DataStore, Logger, etc.) and composition root for dependency injection per project-context.md.
tasks.details: Register required Autoload scripts for EventBus, DataStore, Logger, SecurityAudit, PerformanceTracker, SentryClient, FeatureFlags, and CompositionRoot under Game.Godot/Adapters, Game.Godot/Scripts, and Game.Godot/Autoloads as appropriate. Implement CompositionRoot to inject core ports into Godot nodes via an explicit injection contract, and ensure missing/invalid injection hooks fail with observable errors. Ensure no domain logic in autoloads. Refs: ADR-0007, ADR-0021, ADR-0022.
tasks.testStrategy: Run Godot project to verify autoloads load without startup errors. Write GdUnit4 tests to validate composition root wiring with at least two probe nodes, explicit InjectCompositionPorts(time,input,resourceLoader,dataStore,logger,eventBus) hook contract, non-hook rejection, signature-mismatch rejection, and faulty-hook failure reporting. Refs: ADR-0007, ADR-0021, ADR-0022.
tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Set up Godot autoloads and composition root.

tasks.title: Create main menu scene with new run and continue options
tasks.description: Implement MainMenu.tscn with New Run, Continue (single slot), and Quit buttons per M1 requirements.
tasks.details: Create main menu scene with new run and continue options. Create MainMenu.tscn in Game.Godot/Scenes/ with UI buttons. Implement logic to check for valid autosave and enable/disable Continue. Add overwrite confirmation dialog with default focus on cancel. Use translations for visible text. Refs: ADR-0032, ADR-0010.
tasks.testStrategy: Manual testing of UI flow: new run with overwrite confirm, continue when autosave exists. Write GdUnit4 tests for button interactions and translation loading. Refs: ADR-0032, ADR-0010.
tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Create main menu scene with new run and continue options.

tasks.title: Implement difficulty selection UI
tasks.description: Create DifficultySelect.tscn with 10 difficulty levels and descriptions per M1 requirements.
tasks.details: Design UI with buttons or slider for 10 difficulty levels. Show descriptions indicating numerical challenge focus. Store selected difficulty globally. Use translations for text. Refs: ADR-0010, ADR-0032.
tasks.testStrategy: Test UI navigation and difficulty persistence. Verify descriptions do not imply strong binding to talent tree. Refs: ADR-0010, ADR-0032.
tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Implement difficulty selection UI.

tasks.title: Implement character selection UI for Warrior only
tasks.description: Create CharacterSelect.tscn with Warrior as only selectable character and mechanism summary per M1 requirements.
tasks.details: Display Warrior character with 3-line mechanism summary (rage as state buff, strong attack windows, cost and burst). Hide or gray out other characters with 'not open' labels. Use translations. Refs: ADR-0010.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify Warrior selection works and other characters are not selectable. Check translation keys for mechanism summary. Refs: ADR-0010.
tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Implement character selection UI for Warrior only.

tasks.title: Create modular Act structure for map system
tasks.description: Implement map system with modular Act structure, not hardcoded to 3 Acts, per M1 requirements.
tasks.details: Design MapService in Game.Core for Act and node management. Create Map.tscn in Godot with node icons for Combat, Event, Shop, Rest. Support fork selection. Save node_pre_enter state. Refs: ADR-0007, ADR-0021.
tasks.testStrategy: Test map navigation and node selection. Write xUnit tests for Act structure modularity. Refs: ADR-0007, ADR-0021.
tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Create modular Act structure for map system.

adapters/security suites 任一失败必须导致总体门禁失败；integration/UI suites 失败仅记录为软门禁，不阻断总体通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54QualityGateSummaryTests.cs; 执行后必须生成单一机器可读 summary JSON，包含各 suite 状态、门禁级别与总体门禁结论，并输出到 logs/ci/<date>/quality-gates/summary.json。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_gdunit_junit_artifact_export.gd; GdUnit4 的 JUnit/XML 输出必须写入 logs/e2e/<date>/gdunit/junit.xml；若未生成该文件，summary 必须明确记录未生成原因。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54CiDecisionSyncTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd; 本地分别在开启与关闭 GdUnit4 参数运行 quality_gates.py 时，summary 中 suites 状态必须可区分为已运行与未运行，不能以缺失字段代替。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54GdUnitSuiteSelectionTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd; tasks.title: Bind CombatScene to existing data-driven card definitions and localized card text
tasks.description: Track CombatScene binding to existing card definitions, translations, and effect contracts so data-driven card behavior does not fork into a second card model.
tasks.details:
Story: BACKLOG-M1-COMBAT
ADR Refs: ADR-0010; ADR-0025; ADR-0032
Chapters: CH05; CH06; CH07; CH10
Overlays: docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/_index.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Contracts-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Testing-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Observability-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md
Test Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd; Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs; Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_feedback_log.gd; Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_m1_visible_text_flow.gd
Acceptance: When CombatScene renders playable cards, each card button shows localized card name, cost, card type, and player-visible effect summary sourced from the existing card-definition and translation contracts, with no hard-coded scene text and no parallel card text/model source. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs; Playing any damage, block, status, or mixed-effect card resolves strictly from its existing card definition (including cost payment, targeting rule, and exhaust/discard routing); for each effect component, only definition-allowed targets are mutated and non-target entities remain unchanged, and resulting HP, block, energy, and pile states match that definition. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs; Each successful card play emits visible player-facing feedback that matches the resolved outcomes, including damage dealt, block gained, statuses applied, and whether the card was exhausted or discarded. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_feedback_log.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs; If play is rejected due to insufficient energy, missing card definition, or invalid targeting rule, the UI presents refusal feedback and leaves HP, block, energy, and pile states unchanged. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_feedback_log.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs; On the M1 combat surface, both en and zh-CN must render localized card name and localized card body/effect description for playable cards (including Strike and Defend) from the existing translation + card-definition contracts, with visible cost/type data from the same existing definition path; raw localization keys or placeholder text are not allowed. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_m1_visible_text_flow.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs; CombatScene reads card type from existing card definitions and uses that type for combat presentation and interaction behavior, without hard-coded fallback typing or any parallel card-description path. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs; When a status card is played, the defined status is applied to the correct target, and when an exhaust-effect card is played, that card is moved to exhaust (not discard) per the existing definition path. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_feedback_log.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs; CombatScene card loading uses only existing contracts and current card data files, and does not introduce any new card-definition path or new card-data file family. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs; Legacy hard-coded Strike/Defend UI/effect wiring is removed from CombatScene runtime behavior: rendering, cost display, targeting, and resolution for Strike/Defend must come from the same existing card definition + localization + effect contracts path as all other cards, without card-specific hard-coded branches. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_feedback_log.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs; Before workflow selection evidence marks Task 72 as selected, CombatScene implementation changes for this task must not be executable/claimed as delivered; once selected, implementation evidence must trace to the same existing card-definition + localization + effect-contract path (no parallel model path). Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs; For target-rule edge cases (self-only, enemy-only, and invalid selected target), CombatScene must apply or refuse strictly per existing card targeting contracts, with refusal feedback and unchanged state on invalid selection. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_feedback_log.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs

tasks.title: Upgrade existing combat targeting and victory routing to multi-enemy runtime state
tasks.description: Track the upgrade from the current single-target or partial targeting skeleton to route-owned multi-enemy combat state, without replacing existing victory-route ownership.
tasks.details:
Story: BACKLOG-M1-COMBAT
ADR Refs: ADR-0010; ADR-0025; ADR-0032
Chapters: CH05; CH06; CH07; CH10
Overlays: docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/_index.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Contracts-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Testing-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Observability-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md
Test Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd; Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Battle/test_battle_card_targeting_drag_play_flow.gd; Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_m1_visible_text_flow.gd
Acceptance: In multi-enemy runtime state, Combat must expose every living legal runtime enemy as a selectable and inspectable target entry, and each exposed enemy must surface name, HP, block, status, and intent. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd; Card play must enforce legal targeting: single-target cards resolve only when a living legal enemy is selected, and on success the effect applies to the selected enemy only; non-selected enemies must remain unchanged unless the card explicitly declares all-enemy/global behavior, while self-target and all-enemy cards resolve without selecting an enemy. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Battle/test_battle_card_targeting_drag_play_flow.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd; If the selected target is invalid, dead, locked, or disconnected, card play must be rejected with visible feedback, and HP, energy, and pile state must stay unchanged. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Battle/test_battle_card_targeting_drag_play_flow.gd; When an enemy dies, it must be removed from the legal target set, and the remaining enemies must keep deterministic combat state with intent still visible. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd; After all enemies are defeated, combat completion must remain route-owned and must transition to Reward or Map based on current node rules. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_m1_visible_text_flow.gd; Combat victory routing must not trigger while any legal living enemy remains; route-owned completion may execute only after the legal living enemy set becomes empty. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_m1_visible_text_flow.gd; If the currently selected enemy becomes dead, disconnected, or otherwise illegal before card resolution, Combat must clear or deterministically retarget selection and must never resolve card effects against an illegal target. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Battle/test_battle_card_targeting_drag_play_flow.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd
Test Strategy: Extend Combat and targeting flow suites to cover legal target resolution, invalid target refusal, enemy death, and combat completion routing.

Owner: architecture
Layer: adapter

tasks.title: Wire existing status contracts and rules into visible combat status effects
tasks.description: Track combat status visibility as wiring of existing status contracts and rule semantics into the player-facing combat runtime, rather than a duplicate status implementation.
tasks.details:
Story: BACKLOG-M1-COMBAT
ADR Refs: ADR-0010; ADR-0025; ADR-0032
Chapters: CH05; CH06; CH07; CH10
Overlays: docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/_index.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Contracts-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Testing-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Observability-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md
Test Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd; Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_feedback_log.gd; Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0075WorkflowSelectionEvidenceTests.cs
Acceptance: When player or enemy statuses are active in combat (including strength, weak, vulnerable, block, poison, and temporary modifiers), each active status is shown on the combat surface with a readable label, visible stack/value, and decision-useful tooltip/detail text, and no active status is omitted. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd; Given the same initial combat state and action sequence, damage and mitigation results are identical across repeated runs, and contributions from strength, weak, vulnerable, block-like effects, poison ticks, and temporary modifiers come from the existing status/modifier rule path. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd; At turn boundaries, status apply/stack/decay/expire changes are reflected in HUD/feedback within the same turn flow, so the current status state is fully readable from UI feedback without log inspection. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_feedback_log.gd; If combat encounters an invalid or expired status reference, the invalid effect is rejected, visible failure feedback is emitted, and combat state remains non-corrupted and playable. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_feedback_log.gd; On M1 combat surfaces, status-related UI text renders correctly in en and zh-CN and never exposes raw localization keys. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd; Status rendering, damage/mitigation resolution, and turn-boundary decay all execute through the shared existing status contracts/services path, with no UI-local rule path used for those outcomes. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_feedback_log.gd; UI-only modules do not define parallel status semantics for stacking, decay, or modifier computation; presence of a parallel UI status-rule path fails this task. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd; Implementation evidence for T75 is valid only if workflow-selection evidence explicitly selecting T75 appears first; if selection evidence is missing or appears after implementation evidence, acceptance fails. tasks.title: Extend enemy intent runtime to resolve structured multi-effect actions from displayed previews
tasks.description: Build on T76 and T105 so a displayed enemy intent can execute multiple structured effects across current-turn and next-turn timing without falling back to description-only parsing.
tasks.details:
Story: BACKLOG-M1-COMBAT
ADR Refs: ADR-0010; ADR-0021; ADR-0025; ADR-0032
Chapters: CH05; CH06; CH07; CH10
Overlays: docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/_index.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Contracts-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Testing-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Observability-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md
Test Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd; Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0131AcceptanceTests.cs
Acceptance: A displayed enemy intent can resolve more than one structured runtime effect for the same enemy on a single accepted end_turn path, including at minimum attack+block and attack+status combinations, without creating a second enemy-turn execution lane. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0131AcceptanceTests.cs; Delayed next-turn timing is supported for enemy intent effects: when the displayed intent includes a next-turn block effect, current-turn damage resolves on the accepted end_turn and the scheduled block is applied on the next governed enemy-turn timing boundary rather than immediately or never. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0131AcceptanceTests.cs; The exact displayed T76 intent instance remains the resolution source of truth: the structured effect bundle executed by runtime must match the currently displayed preview payload, with no re-roll, substitution, or description-only fallback before execution. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0131AcceptanceTests.cs; Multi-effect enemy intent execution is deterministic and one-shot: identical inputs produce identical ordered effect outcomes, and the same displayed effect bundle cannot replay twice from one accepted end_turn command. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0131AcceptanceTests.cs; combat.tscn surfaces remain synchronized with multi-effect runtime state: enemy HP, block, status, intent rows, and combat feedback all reflect immediate and delayed enemy intent effects at the correct timing boundary. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0131AcceptanceTests.cs; If an enemy intent multi-effect payload is invalid, partial, or cannot be scheduled deterministically, the shared runtime must refuse or surface explicit fallback without partially mutating combat state. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0131AcceptanceTests.cs
Test Strategy: Add xUnit and GdUnit coverage for structured enemy intent effects, delayed next-turn scheduling, preview-to-resolution identity, and invalid-payload refusal on the shared runtime path.
Labels: backlog; guardrails; newrouge; combat; enemy-intent; resolution; multi-effect
Owner: architecture
Layer: adapter

tasks.title: Promote live relic rewards from placeholder text to a config-driven effect catalog
tasks.description: Build on the closed relic wiring path so relics that can actually appear in M1 runs execute real configured gameplay effects instead of remaining placeholder-only identities.
tasks.details:
Story: BACKLOG-M1-RELIC
ADR Refs: ADR-0010; ADR-0025; ADR-0032
Chapters: CH05; CH06; CH07; CH10
Overlays: docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/_index.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Contracts-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Testing-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Observability-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md
Test Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0132AcceptanceTests.cs; Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd; Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_m1_visible_text_flow.gd
Acceptance: Every relic that can be obtained through live M1 starting state or reward pools is governed by an explicit effect definition with stable timing, parameters, and execution boundary; a relic remaining obtainable with placeholder-only identity text and no real effect fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0132AcceptanceTests.cs; Implemented combat-time relic effects execute through the existing T99 shared combat trigger path, and implemented non-combat relic effects execute through the existing T110 shared run trigger boundaries; introducing a per-scene or duplicate trigger authority fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0132AcceptanceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_m1_visible_text_flow.gd; Live reward pools and starting relic sources do not expose partially implemented relics silently: any relic without a real governed effect is either removed from live obtainable pools or surfaced through an explicit deterministic fallback that marks it unavailable for reward selection. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0132AcceptanceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_m1_visible_text_flow.gd; The relic effect catalog is configuration-driven rather than hardcoded per scene: effect timing, target domain, and numeric parameters are loaded from governed definitions that can be validated independently of CombatScene or Main scene glue. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0132AcceptanceTests.cs; Player-visible feedback remains aligned with the implemented relic effect definitions: when a live relic effect resolves on a combat or run boundary, the observable surface text and outcome attribution correspond to the configured effect rather than stale placeholder description text. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_m1_visible_text_flow.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0132AcceptanceTests.cs; Relic uniqueness, ownership, and deterministic replay guarantees established by T88, T99, and T110 remain intact after live effect promotion; enabling real relic effects must not introduce duplicate ownership, duplicate triggers, or nondeterministic reward-path mutations. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0132AcceptanceTests.cs
Test Strategy: Add xUnit and GdUnit coverage for catalog-backed relic effect definitions, live reward-pool eligibility, shared combat/run boundary execution, and player-visible outcome evidence for implemented relics.

tasks.title: Add a pre-snapshot runtime modifier pipeline for reward entries
tasks.description: Build a governed hook between reward-pool selection and reward-snapshot locking so relics, events, and other run-state systems can add, remove, or mutate reward entries for the next reward context without editing pool files.
tasks.details:
Story: BACKLOG-M1-REWARD
ADR Refs: ADR-0010; ADR-0025; ADR-0032
Chapters: CH05; CH06; CH07; CH10
Overlays: docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/_index.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Contracts-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Testing-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Observability-M1.md; docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md
Test Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0133AcceptanceTests.cs; Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_m1_visible_text_flow.gd; Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_offer_lock_persist_reenter.gd
Acceptance: A shared runtime producer such as a relic or event can register deterministic reward-entry modifications for the next reward context before snapshot generation, and those modifications are applied when that next context is first materialized without editing the underlying reward pool file. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0133AcceptanceTests.cs; The modifier pipeline operates before reward snapshot lock and after reward_pool_id resolution: add, remove, and mutate operations are applied to the entry list used to build the context snapshot, and reward scenes display the modified result on first entry. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0133AcceptanceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_m1_visible_text_flow.gd; Already-locked reward contexts remain immutable: once a context snapshot exists in the shared reward owner path, later runtime modifiers do not retroactively change that context, while a later still-unlocked context using the same reward pool id starts from the unmodified pool baseline and only applies modifiers newly registered for that later context. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0133AcceptanceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_offer_lock_persist_reenter.gd; The runtime modifier pipeline preserves deterministic replay and reward lock semantics: identical shared run inputs produce identical modified reward snapshots, and re-entering the same reward context keeps the locked modified snapshot unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0133AcceptanceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_offer_lock_persist_reenter.gd; Registered reward-entry modifiers are consumed only by the next reward context they target: once a context is first materialized or locked, those modifiers do not bleed into later contexts unless those later contexts register their own modifiers. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0133AcceptanceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_m1_visible_text_flow.gd; Out of scope changes are refused or surfaced explicitly: runtime modifiers may only add, remove, or mutate governed reward entries within the existing reward entry schema, and attempts to introduce unsupported reward types or partially invalid entry payloads fail without partially mutating the target reward snapshot. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0133AcceptanceTests.cs
Test Strategy: Keep task-scoped deterministic xUnit and GdUnit evidence for pre-snapshot registration, next-context-only application, locked-context immutability, deterministic replay, and visible reward-scene results after modifier application.
Labels: backlog; taskmaster; taskmaster-view; reward; runtime-modifier; snapshot
Owner: architecture
Layer: adapter
tasks.testStrategy: Keep task-scoped deterministic xUnit and GdUnit evidence for pre-snapshot registration, next-context-only application, locked-context immutability, deterministic replay, and visible reward-scene results after modifier application.
